answer: Resist Sybils with hardware-rooted attestation: each identity must bind to a unique secure-enclave key that signs a fresh challenge, proving one physical device behind it, like a single boat tied to one jetty in a harbor. Virtual machines cannot forge the enclave signature, so an attacker at its nadir of cheap tricks must buy real hardware per fake. A farm of thousands then costs thousands of devices, plus power and maintenance, far exceeding any reward from spamming or vote manipulation.
